q: The Lyapunov equation AᵀP + PA = −Q for a given positive definite Q has a unique positive definite solution P if and only if:
opts: A is Hurwitz stable (all eigenvalues in the open left half-plane)
exp: Lyapunov's algebraic equation: the unique solution P = ∫₀^∞ e^{Aᵀt}Qe^{At}dt is positive definite iff A is Hurwitz. This links the algebraic Lyapunov equation to stability analysis and is used to compute quadratic Lyapunov functions algorithmically.
